scope: One local frozen diagnostic of full value bank, observed selection and averaging; no model implementation or fitting
population: Reuse the identical 8192 train targets per dataset and the existing two disjoint-series folds; do not load parquet or new targets

definitions.quantity_slot_projection: value dot checkpoint quantity head weight, before softplus
definitions.time_slot_projection: value dot checkpoint time head weight, before intercept clamp
definitions.full_uniform: All 64 slots equally weighted, including slots not selected in this sample
definitions.active_union_uniform: Uniform over slots appearing in cached top4
definitions.selected_mass: Slot probability equals its actual cached attention weight summed over all queries, divided by query count
definitions.weight_roundoff: Accept sums within absolute 1e-6 of one; normalize in float64 for probability identities; separately verify original float32 outputs without normalization
definitions.decomposition: Selected marginal variance = variance of per-query weighted mean + mean per-query weighted within variance; also compute vector covariance traces
definitions.head_scaling_control: Report raw projection and unit-head projection variance divided by centered vector covariance trace
definitions.effective_rank: exp entropy of normalized squared singular values of centered sqrt-mass-weighted values
definitions.averaging_control: Compare actual weights with uniform weights on the same cached top4; no new retrieval or model evaluation
definitions.time_effect: Clamp(a0 + sum(alpha * value_dot_time), max=L) - clamp(a0, max=L), where a0 = v_t(h) + b_t; upper clamp only as in legacy training loss

integrity: Verify all recorded prior model/data-loader/script source digests and prior contract digest
Verify checkpoint files, canonical state digests, launch contracts and cache digests against their existing records
Reproduce cached quantity slot projections, summed memory contribution and final quantity logits
Verify selected retrieval scores and weights against checkpoint keys without asserting index order across near ties
Verify finite geometry, variance identities and unchanged checkpoint state after diagnosis
interpretation: Large full-bank spread but small selected-mass spread localizes an observed restriction to selection; it does not prove unused slots useful
Small full-bank quantity spread would support investigating value/head directions; geometry alone does not establish a deficient learning signal
Large within-query share shows that averaging reduces variation; it does not prove harmful cancellation or justify a new fusion model
Greater time than quantity normalized variation is only a directional role difference; it does not establish task conflict, timing accuracy or time NLL
Report continuous values and agreement across existing train folds; no post-result performance or architecture adoption threshold
stop_condition: After one bounded diagnostic, identify a supported bottleneck or explicitly conclude that a single value/fusion implementation hypothesis is not justified
limitations: Frozen models were trained on these rows and selected using validation; this is not an independent generalization estimate
Same slot numbers across separately trained models are not semantically aligned
Unused means absent from this sample, not untrained or unhelpful
No target gap is available in the allowed cache fields; do not report time NLL or target-conditioned gradient conflicts
Checkpoint geometry cannot establish which architecture change will improve a freshly trained model
